protocol_type: Queue-pair (SQ/CQ) command-completion protocol layered on PCI Express. Host fills a 64-byte Submission Queue Entry, rings the SQ Tail Doorbell; controller fetches via PCIe Memory Read, executes, writes back a 16-byte Completion Queue Entry, signals MSI-X interrupt; host rings the CQ Head Doorbell to release the slot.

common_dword_0_fields.name: Command Identifier (CID)
common_dword_0_fields.description: Unique per-SQ identifier assigned by host; combined with SQID uniquely identifies an outstanding command.

common_dword_0_fields.name: PRP or SGL for Data Transfer (PSDT)
common_dword_0_fields.description: 00b = PRPs (mandatory for Admin in NVMe-over-PCIe); 01b = SGLs with contiguous metadata buffer; 10b = SGLs with single-descriptor metadata SGL segment; 11b = Reserved.

common_dword_0_fields.name: Fused Operation (FUSE)
common_dword_0_fields.description: 00b = Normal; 01b = Fused First; 10b = Fused Second; 11b = Reserved.

common_dword_0_fields.name: Opcode (OPC)
common_dword_0_fields.description: Command opcode (Admin OPC space 0x00..0x7F + 0xC0..0xFFh vendor; I/O OPC space 0x00..0x7F + 0x80..0xBFh I/O Set Specific + 0xC0..0xFFh vendor).

common_command_layout.name: Namespace Identifier (NSID)
common_command_layout.description: Target namespace; FFFFFFFFh = broadcast; 0h = not used for command.

common_command_layout.name: Metadata Pointer (MPTR)
common_command_layout.description: 64-bit pointer to metadata buffer; alignment depends on PSDT and metadata format.

common_command_layout.name: Data Pointer (DPTR)
common_command_layout.description: If PSDT=00b: PRP Entry 1 (24:31) + PRP Entry 2 (32:39); if PSDT=01b/10b: SGL Entry 1 (24:39).

layout.name: Command Specific
layout.description: Per-command-opcode payload (e.g. number of dwords in log page returned).

layout.name: SQ Identifier (SQID)
layout.description: SQID this completion came from; combined with CID uniquely identifies the command.

layout.name: SQ Head Pointer (SQHD)
layout.description: Current SQ Head Pointer for the SQ in SQID; how controller communicates SQ head advance.

layout.name: Phase Tag (P)
layout.description: Inverted each pass through CQ ring; allows phase-tag polling of CQ without doorbell read.

layout.name: Command Identifier (CID)
layout.description: CID echoed from CDW0 of the originating SQE.

status_field_structure.DNR_bit: 31  — Do Not Retry; if 1, host should not retry the same command.
status_field_structure.M_bit: 30  — More; if 1, additional status info is in Error Information log.
status_field_structure.CRD: 29:28 — Command Retry Delay (selects CRDT1/2/3 in Identify Controller).
status_field_structure.SCT: 27:25 — Status Code Type: 0h Generic, 1h Command Specific, 2h Media/Data Integrity, 3h Path Related, 7h Vendor Specific.

admin_command_set.name: Delete I/O Submission Queue
admin_command_set.description: Deletes the I/O SQ specified by CDW10.QID.

admin_command_set.name: Create I/O Submission Queue
admin_command_set.description: Creates an I/O SQ; QID in CDW10[15:0]; QSIZE in CDW10[31:16]; QPRIO in CDW11[2:1]; PC in CDW11[0]; CQID in CDW11[31:16].

admin_command_set.name: Get Log Page
admin_command_set.description: Retrieves a log page; LID in CDW10[7:0]; NUMD in CDW10[27:16] + CDW11[15:0]; LPOL/LPOU in CDW12/13; UUID Index in CDW14[6:0].

admin_command_set.name: Delete I/O Completion Queue
admin_command_set.description: Deletes the I/O CQ specified by CDW10.QID; all associated SQs must be deleted first.

admin_command_set.name: Create I/O Completion Queue
admin_command_set.description: Creates an I/O CQ; QID in CDW10[15:0]; QSIZE in CDW10[31:16]; IV (interrupt vector) in CDW11[31:16]; IEN in CDW11[1]; PC in CDW11[0].

admin_command_set.name: Identify
admin_command_set.description: Returns 4 KB Identify structure; CNS in CDW10[7:0] selects type (00h NS, 01h Controller, 02h Active NS List, 03h NS Identification Descriptor List, 10h Allocated NS List, 11h NS, 12h Attached CTRL List, 13h CTRL List, 14h Primary Controller Capabilities, 15h Secondary Controller List).

admin_command_set.name: Abort
admin_command_set.description: Aborts the command identified by SQID (CDW10[31:16]) and CID (CDW10[15:0]).

admin_command_set.name: Set Features
admin_command_set.description: Sets a Feature; FID in CDW10[7:0]; SV=CDW10[31] = save.

admin_command_set.name: Get Features
admin_command_set.description: Retrieves a Feature; SEL=CDW10[10:8] = Current/Default/Saved/Supported.

admin_command_set.name: Asynchronous Event Request
admin_command_set.description: Remains outstanding until an asynchronous event occurs; one CQE returned per event (DW0 = event type + log page identifier).

admin_command_set.name: Namespace Management
admin_command_set.description: Create / Delete namespaces; SEL=CDW10[3:0] (0h Create, 1h Delete).

admin_command_set.name: Firmware Commit
admin_command_set.description: Commits firmware image from slot; FS=CDW10[2:0]; CA=CDW10[5:3]; BPID=CDW10[31].

admin_command_set.name: Firmware Image Download
admin_command_set.description: Downloads firmware image fragment; NUMD=CDW10; OFST=CDW11.

admin_command_set.name: Device Self-test
admin_command_set.description: Initiates a controller / namespace self-test; STC=CDW10[3:0] (1h Short, 2h Extended, Fh Abort).

admin_command_set.name: Namespace Attachment
admin_command_set.description: Attaches / detaches a namespace to / from a controller; SEL=CDW10[3:0] (0h Attach, 1h Detach).

admin_command_set.name: Keep Alive
admin_command_set.description: NVMe-oF keep-alive heartbeat; refreshes the Keep Alive Timer.

admin_command_set.name: Directive Send
admin_command_set.description: Sends a Directive (e.g. Streams); DTYPE/DOPER/DSPEC in CDW10/11.

admin_command_set.name: Directive Receive
admin_command_set.description: Receives a Directive's data structure.

admin_command_set.name: Virtualization Management
admin_command_set.description: Manages SR-IOV virtual function resources (primary/secondary controllers).

admin_command_set.name: NVMe-MI Send
admin_command_set.description: Pass-through NVMe-MI command to subsystem.

admin_command_set.name: NVMe-MI Receive
admin_command_set.description: Pass-through NVMe-MI response.

admin_command_set.name: Doorbell Buffer Config
admin_command_set.description: Configures Shadow Doorbell Buffer + EventIdx Buffer for emulated environments (Section 7.13).

admin_command_set.name: Format NVM (NVM Set Specific)
admin_command_set.description: Formats a namespace; LBAF=CDW10[3:0]; MSET=CDW10[4]; PI=CDW10[7:5]; PIL=CDW10[8]; SES=CDW10[11:9].

admin_command_set.name: Security Send
admin_command_set.description: Opaque transport for TCG Opal / IEEE 1667 security commands; SECP/SPSP in CDW10; TL in CDW11.

admin_command_set.name: Security Receive
admin_command_set.description: Reads a security protocol response.

admin_command_set.name: Sanitize
admin_command_set.description: Initiates a Sanitize operation; SANACT=CDW10[2:0] (1h Exit Failure, 2h Block Erase, 3h Overwrite, 4h Crypto Erase).

admin_command_set.name: Get LBA Status
admin_command_set.description: Returns LBA Status Descriptors for ranges; SLBA=CDW10/11; MNDW=CDW12; ATYPE=CDW13[31:24].

nvm_io_command_set.name: Flush
nvm_io_command_set.description: Flushes write-cached data for a namespace to non-volatile media.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Write
nvm_io_command_set.description: Writes data and metadata; SLBA=CDW10/11; NLB=CDW12[15:0]; PRINFO/DSM/FUA/LR in CDW12; DSM hint in CDW13.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Read
nvm_io_command_set.description: Reads data and metadata; SLBA/NLB layout same as Write.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Write Uncorrectable
nvm_io_command_set.description: Marks an LBA range as uncorrectable; subsequent reads return Unrecovered Read Error.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Compare
nvm_io_command_set.description: Compares data buffer to LBA range; pairs with Write to form Compare-and-Write (Fused).

nvm_io_command_set.name: Write Zeroes
nvm_io_command_set.description: Writes zero data for an LBA range without host-supplied data buffer.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Dataset Management
nvm_io_command_set.description: Hints about LBA range usage (e.g. trim/deallocate).

nvm_io_command_set.name: Verify
nvm_io_command_set.description: Verifies that an LBA range is readable without returning data.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Reservation Register
nvm_io_command_set.description: Registers a reservation key for a namespace.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Reservation Report
nvm_io_command_set.description: Returns reservation status for a namespace.

nvm_io_command_set.name: Reservation Acquire
nvm_io_command_set.description: Acquires a reservation; RACQA=CDW10[2:0] (0h Acquire, 1h Preempt, 2h Preempt-and-Abort).

nvm_io_command_set.name: Reservation Release
nvm_io_command_set.description: Releases or clears a reservation; RRELA=CDW10[2:0].

fused_operations.description: Two adjacent SQ entries fused into a single atomic operation; first has FUSE=01b, second has FUSE=10b.
fused_operations.canonical_example: Compare (0x05) followed by Write (0x01) — Compare-and-Write atomic semantics.

queue_doorbell_protocol.host_submits_command: Host fills next free SQ slot; writes SQyTDBL = new Tail.
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_fetches: Controller issues PCIe Memory Read TLP targeting SQE; reads 64 bytes; SQ Head advances internally but not visibly to host until next CQE.
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_executes: Controller executes (reading/writing data per PRP/SGL via PCIe TLPs).
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_completes: Controller issues PCIe Memory Write TLP posting 16-byte CQE with current SQHD; inverts Phase Tag on ring wrap.
queue_doorbell_protocol.controller_signals: Controller asserts the configured interrupt: MSI-X vector configured via Create I/O CQ.IV, or pin/MSI as applicable.
queue_doorbell_protocol.host_processes: Host polls CQE Phase Tag for new entries, processes them, writes CQyHDBL = new Head.

channels.name: PCIe TL/DL/PL
channels.description: Underlying PCI Express transaction layer carries all SQ fetches, CQ posts, data buffer reads/writes, doorbell writes, and MSI-X interrupts as Memory Read/Memory Write/MSI-X Message TLPs.

channels.name: BAR0/BAR1 MMIO
channels.description: Controller register set; 4 KB minimum for CAP/VS/INTMS/INTMC/CC/CSTS/AQA/ASQ/ACQ; additional region for doorbells; further region for CMB / PMR / Vendor Specific.

channels.name: Host SQ/CQ memory
channels.description: SQ ring buffers + CQ ring buffers in host system memory (or in controller CMB if supported).

channels.name: PRP / SGL data buffers
channels.description: Host data buffers referenced by PRP entries or SGL descriptors in commands.

frame_format.completion_queue_entry: 16 bytes per Figure 121 (DW0 command-specific + DW1 reserved + DW2 SQID:SQHD + DW3 SF:P:CID).
frame_format.prp_entry: 64-bit Page Base Address + Offset; offset width = log2(MPS).
frame_format.sgl_descriptor: 16 bytes; type-specific layout (Data Block / Bit Bucket / Segment / Last Segment / Keyed Data Block / Transport Data Block).
